# Step - times

`times` · category: [Branches and loops](../../traversal/step_reference.md#branches-and-loops)

Within repeat(): runs the loop body exactly n times.

## Forms

```text
times(arg1: i64)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).repeat(__.out()).times(2).values("name").to_list()   // ["ripple", "lop"]
```
